info.title: M2: corrigir reconhecimento de evidencias Windows

parts.text: "Corrija via TDD o exportador evidencias/exportar-evidencias.js: sessoes reais M2 ja exportadas evidencias/sessoes/clara-l-peretti/*.json mostram comandos PowerShell & caminho absoluto entre aspas para dart.exe test e flutter.bat test, mas ehComandoDeTeste nao reconhece e indice mostra zero testes. Adapte reconhecedor de invocacoes Windows (caminhos com espacos, barras, extensoes exe/bat/cmd, & e aspas) preservando suporte Linux, comandos projeto.json, sem contar echo/texto/commit/pub get/analyze como teste. Nao invente contagens nem altere JSONs de sessoes ou resumos manualmente. Falhas reais Dart/Flutter com Failed to load/Some tests failed precisam prevalecer mesmo se pipe Select-Object mascarou exit code; se saida incompleta sem resultado nem codigo confiavel marque sem resultado. Use testes node:test em evidencias/exportar-evidencias.test.js com pequenos fixtures sinteticos explicitamente testes do parser (nao evidencias), TDD vermelho antes correcao; casos positivo path quoted e negativo git commit/echo/analyze/pub get, resultados pass/fail e pipe. Pode exportar funcoes com require.main guard sem mudar fluxo CLI. Preserve historicos Yasmin: ao regenerar use --saida evidencias/sessoes/clara-l-peretti? LEIA CLI antes, caminho correto deve manter pasta Clara sem tocar Yasmin; se --resumir global rescreveria Yasmin, nao use global. Ao final execute node evidencias/exportar-evidencias.js --aluno Clara (usar nome completo Clara L Peretti para manter slug existente), com PATH local opencode configurado; veja real indice. Nao altere teste/processo/artefatos das sessoes de backend/frontend em andamento. Commit somente exportador e seus testes, sem --no-verify sem push, deixando evidencias geradas para commit final. Relate contagens reais e detalhes da compatibilidade. O objetivo e refletir execucoes reais sem manipular historico."

Let me start by understanding the task. The user wants me to fix, via TDD, the exporter `evidencias/exportar-evidencias.js`. The issue:

- Real M2 sessions exported at `evidencias/sessoes/clara-l-peretti/*.json` show PowerShell commands & absolute path in quotes for `dart.exe test` and `flutter.bat test`, but `ehComandoDeTeste` doesn't recognize them and the index shows zero tests.
- Adapt the recognizer of Windows invocations (paths with spaces, slashes, exe/bat/cmd extensions, & and quotes) preserving Linux support, project.json commands, without counting echo/text/commit/pub get/analyze as test.
- Don't invent counts or alter session JSONs or summaries manually.
- Real Dart/Flutter failures like "Failed to load" / "Some tests failed" should prevail even if pipe Select-Object masked exit code; if incomplete output without result nor reliable code mark without result.
- Use node:test in `evidencias/exportar-evidencias.test.js` with small synthetic fixtures explicitly tests of the parser (not evidence), TDD red before fix; positive case quoted path and negative git commit/echo/analyze/pub get, results pass/fail and pipe.
- Can export functions with require.main guard without changing CLI flow.
- Preserve Yasmin histories: when regenerating use `--saida evidencias/sessoes/clara-l-peretti?` READ CLI first, correct path should keep Clara folder without touching Yasmin; if `--resumir global` would rewrite Yasmin, don't use global.
- At the end run `node evidencias/exportar-evidencias.js --aluno Clara` (use full name Clara L Peretti to keep existing slug), with PATH local opencode configured; see real index.
- Don't alter tests/process/artifacts of backend/frontend sessions in progress.
- Commit only exporter and its tests, without --no-verify without push, leaving generated evidence for final commit.
- Report real counts and compatibility details.
- The goal is to reflect real executions without manipulating history.

Let me start by reading the relevant files. Let me explore the evidence directory structure and the exporter file.

Let me use a node one-liner or better, read a specific region of the session JSON. The grep earlier gave line numbers. For `ses_f34d1018dffeoOVd6aBW1KfU2B.json`, line 793 is the command. Let me read around line 780-820 of that file.

Now I understand the structure. `projeto.json` declares `testes: ["dart test", "flutter test"]`. `ehComandoDeTeste` checks `c.includes(declarado)` where `declarado` is normalized ("dart test", "flutter test"). But the actual command is `& "C:\...\dart.exe" test` — which does NOT include "dart test" substring. And the regex `TESTE_CONHECIDO` looks for `\b(dart)\s+test`, but here the command is `& "C:\...\dart.exe" test` — `dart.exe test` — the `\b` boundary between `dart.exe` and `test`... Actually the regex is `(bun|deno|go|cargo|dotnet|mix|flutter|dart|rails)\s+test`. For `flutter.bat test` — `flutter.bat` doesn't match `flutter\s+test`. And `dart.exe test` doesn't match `dart\s+test` because of `.exe` in between. Also there's the `& "..."` quoting prefix.

So the issue: Windows invocations `& "path\to\dart.exe" test`, `& "path\flutter.bat" test`. Need to recognize:
- Implicit binary form: `& "C:\Users\...\dart.exe" test` → dart.exe with `.exe` extension, and command is `test`.
- linux: `dart test`, `flutter test`.
- `flutter.bat test` (relative path with quotes: `& ".tools/flutter/bin/flutter.bat" test`).

Also negative cases: echo/text/commit/pub get/analyze shouldn't count as test.

Also the pipe: `2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15` — that masked the exit code. `state.metadata.exit` — is it present? In the successful case exit: 0. When there's a pipe with `Select-Object`, PowerShell's exit code becomes 0 even if dart failed. But the output contains "Some tests failed" or failures. The requirement: "Falhas reais Dart/Flutter com Failed to load/Some tests failed precisam prevalecer mesmo se pipe Select-Object mascarou exit code; se saida incompleta sem resultado nem codigo confiavel marque sem resultado."

So I need to update `placar` to detect "Some tests failed" / "All tests passed" lines, and treat failure text as red even if exit code is 0 (masked). And the reverse: if output incomplete (truncated by Select-Object -First 25, i.e. the summary line never shown) and exit code unreliable (0 from pipe), mark "sem resultado" (no definitive result).
